# ISSS626-GAA

Welcome to my coursework website for **ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications**. This site contains my hands-on exercises, take-home exercises, and learning notes prepared with R and Quarto.

[View hands-on exercises](hands-on.qmd){.btn .btn-light .home-button}
:::
:::

::: {.home-content}
## Coursework

Use the navigation bar or the sections below to browse the course materials.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

sections <- data.frame(
  title = c("Hands-on Exercises", "Take-home Exercises"),
  description = c(
    "Guided practice in geospatial data handling, mapping, and visualisation with R.",
    "Independent analytical projects developed throughout the course."
  ),
  link = c("hands-on.html", "take-home.html"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(sections)), function(i) {
  paste0(
    '<article class="course-card">',
    '<h3>', sections$title[i], '</h3>',
    '<p>', sections$description[i], '</p>',
    '<a href="', sections$link[i], '">Open section →</a>',
    '</article>'
  )
}, character(1))

cat('<div class="course-grid">', paste(cards, collapse = ""), '</div>')
```

::: {.site-note}
### About this website

The source files are maintained in GitHub and the rendered Quarto website is published on Netlify. The content will be updated as new coursework is completed.
:::
